description: Persistent footer with actions and information provided by the application; does not validate forms.

howToUse: Use it at the bottom of long forms, so Save and Cancel stay in reach.
Put the state in `start` ("Unsaved changes", "2 errors"), and the buttons on the right.
Your form validates and blocks Save when needed.
alternatives: Context and actions at the top: StickyBar.

keyboard.action: Moves through the actions of the footer.

props.name: start
props.description: Left slot: state info, error count, "unsaved changes".

props.name: position
props.description:
`sticky` (default) sticks to the end of the nearest scroll container;
`fixed` fixes to the viewport and inserts a spacer so it does not cover content.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
